channel.title: Vanshul Goyal — Blog
channel.description: Writing on AI, the future of work, technology and space by Vanshul Goyal.

item.title: Taste Is the Last Moat
item.description: When anyone can generate code, art, and writing for free, producing stops being rare. The scarce skill becomes taste and judgment — knowing what's worth making, and what's true.

item.title: Will Money Ever Become Obsolete?
item.description: One camp says extreme abundance — robots plus limitless solar energy — will make money pointless. The other says scarcity is permanent, and so is the tool built to manage it. The disagreement is really about what money is for.

item.title: The Two Worlds
item.description: Developing nations are fighting for clean water and reliable roads. Developed nations are building AI and racing to Mars. Are we living in two different worlds?

item.title: The New Leverage
item.description: Work feels meaningful when we create value. Historically, this required leverage like capital or labor. Today, Agentic AI and Robotics offer new, exponential leverage to everyone.

item.title: Can we create a silicon valley in India?
item.description: Should India copy America's Silicon Valley model or build a unique tech culture rooted in its own traditions...

item.title: Preserving Stories
item.description: Using AI to preserve personal stories, while also considering immense privacy challenges...

item.title: Health in a Post-AGI World
item.description: In a post-AGI world of abundance, humanity's focus shifts from work to the holistic pursuit of health and well-being.

item.title: Meat Without The Animal
item.description: What if meat wasn't something we harvested, but something we designed? Exploring the world of cultivated meat and how it could change our relationship with food itself.
